name: work.resumebooster/jobs
title: Resume Booster Job Board
description: Job search over employers' own hiring systems. Search, read and apply yourself with no key.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. A free rb_live_ key from https://resumebooster.work/data-api, sent as Bearer <key>. Without it board_stats, search_jobs, search, fetch, get_job, get_jobs, check_jobs_open, employer_hiring_record, employer_growth and apply_myself still answer.
